prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: Trend champion is rf with perfect correlation (1.0), while seasonality champion is ONLY_DWT_catboost (0.7963). Overall champion ONLY_FT_catboost has lowest RMSE (120.35) but rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=0.2865) with high model disagreement, so robust median/trimmed_mean combination is recommended over single model selection.
